significance: A red-sandstone Shiva temple built by Chola rulers at Nedungadu in Karaikal district. Excavations in 1948 recovered 14th-century bronze sculptures from the site.
story: The village's name is said to come from the goddess Nedunthuyar Theertha Nayaki, consort of Tantondreeswara, whose name means the one who ended the people's long sorrow.
